parallels.note: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

translations.web: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy; and stay there until you go on.
translations.bsb: Whatever town or village you enter, find out who is worthy there and stay at his house until you move on.
translations.kjv: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
translations.asv: And into whatsoever city or village ye shall enter, search out who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go forth.
